text: Level two, question three: A, B and C invest capitals in the ratio a third, a quarter and a sixth for the same period; the profit is forty-five thousand rupees; find each share. Question four: A starts with one lakh rupees and withdraws forty thousand after three months; B invests eighty thousand for the whole year; the profit is sixty thousand; find each share. Question five: A and B start with forty thousand and fifty thousand rupees; after six months, A adds twenty thousand and B withdraws ten thousand; the year's profit is thirty-eight thousand; find each share.
